Tan Yu Hng, Isaac
Mobile: (+65) 94391107 | Email: yuhng1@hotmail.com | LinkedIn: Tan Yu Hng
WORK EXPERIENCE
Munich Re | Data Science Intern Jun 2026 – Present
- Engineering PySpark pipelines on Azure Databricks using Medallion architecture, automating health insurance reporting and
improving data quality for regional actuarial teams.
- Building GenAI-enabled claims assessment and fraud detection pipelines for health insurance, integrating OCR, RAG and
LLM-based extraction across diverse claim types.
Publicis Groupe | Data Intelligence Analyst Intern Jan 2026 – Jun 2026
- Engineered BigQuery pipelines processing 3TB+ Ad data, developing Looker Studio dashboards to improve APAC campaign
visibility for Samsung and PepsiCo.
- Optimize media spend through cross-channel Share of Voice analysis to improve budget allocation
Schneider Electric | EA Data Analyst Intern Jun 2025 – Dec 2025
- Built Python, Informatica, and SQL ETL pipelines to establish a regional single source of truth, cutting manual reporting
effort by 80% across East Asia.
- Designed 10+ Tableau dashboards and reusable SQL frameworks to standardize operational reporting and KPI visibility
across regional business teams.
Aspial Corporation | Data Analyst Intern Jul 2024 – Nov 2024
- Developed 20+ Tableau dashboards for real-time sales performance and fraud detection to monitor retail and brokerage
operations.
- Supported enterprise migration from Tableau to Power BI by mapping data models and row-level security to ensure reporting
continuity.
PROJECT EXPERIENCE
FAWSURE Claims Assessment Platform (Munich Re) | Data Science Jun 2026 – Present
- Migrating and deploying local application to Databricks Apps, integrating frontend and backend services through FastAPI
- Developing React features for drag-and-drop claims ingestions and RAG search with scanned-PDF citations to streamline
verification
- Developing a hybrid claims-validation pipeline combining RAG-based policy reasoning and deterministic checks to assess
claims exceeding benefits limits
- Building an evaluation harness using LLM-as-Judge and deterministics checks to assess extraction accuracy for fraud, abuse,
waste, and claims-validity assessments
VITALS Medical Classification Pipeline (Munich Re) | Data Science Jun 2026 – Present
- Engineering PySpark ELT pipelines in Databricks to transform multi-client policy and claims data into analytics-ready Delta
Lake tables
- Designed modular transformation frameworks to handle schema harmonization, lookup enrichment, date parsing, and
complex premium & reinsurance calculations across disparate source formats.
PAI BI Service Automation Pipeline (Publicis Groupe) | Data Intelligence Analyst Mar 2026 - Jun 2026
- Developed a pipeline to automate social media extraction, supporting concurrent downloads and configurable media retrieval
- Implemented parallelized video-to-GIF conversion and asynchronous download workflows using multiprocessing and
asyncio to optimize efficiency.
Sales Incentive Program (SIP) Automation Pipeline (Schneider Electric) | EA Data Analyst Aug 2025 - Dec 2025
- Developed a modular Python ETL pipeline to automate regional SIP reporting, consolidating multi-source commercial data
into a standardized workflow cutting manual processing time by 80% across East Asia.
- Implemented validation, logging, exception handling, and reusable modules to improve reliability and maintainability.
SKILLS
Programming: Python (Pandas, Polars, pySpark), SQL (Postgres, BigQuery, MySQL)
CI/CD Tools: Docker, Github Actions
AI/ML Frameworks: Scikit-Learn, LangChain, HuggingFace
Cloud Platforms: AWS, GCP, Databricks
Certification: dbt Fundamentals, Databricks GenAI Fundamentals, IBM AI Engineering, Google Advanced Data Analytics
EDUCATION
UOL BSc (Honours) Data Science and Business Analytics | Graduate Aug 2023 – Aug 2026
- Relevant modules: Business Analytics, Advanced Statistics, Machine Learning, Statistical Methods for Market Research
